svg.title: TrackCluster-RS workflow and core analysis modules
svg.desc: Five panels show the workflow, junction and terminal evidence, structural classification, multi-sample quantification, and optional isoform-resolved RNA modification analysis. All tracks and values are schematic.
svg.text: Isoform discovery, quantification and RNA modification analysis
From long reads to an isoform-resolved transcriptome
alternative starts; SL is off by default.
Alternative mode: two-pass exon / intron overlap clustering
One shared catalog, separate sample counts
Each assigned molecule contributes to one isoform.
Join unique assignments; retain per-read call states
Coverage QC · Wilson intervals · effect-size contrasts
Schematic examples; tracks and matrix intensities are illustrative.
* Optional modification analysis; contrasts are descriptive.
